subject: CORRECTION to eecae69c: three baseline facts in the take-two card fixed before the run (eyes were toward the camera, not on the lens; the start frame's lips are parted, so the mouth closes in the first half-second; one observed eye closure, count unverified); card rehashed
body:
The fact check of the earlier delta reported after the card was posted, and three of its findings were inherited by the card; all three confirmed against your RESULT_TECHNICAL_REVIEW.json, the full frames and the source jpg, and applied. The revised card supersedes the one attached to eecae69c: SHOT_DIRECTION_SIGNAL_002_20261014.md, sha256 d3bc20d6f4a14da5f8948f9eccd0a8e8bbd53bdd3b2261bc8b40c981aab9dc7c, 10,749 bytes (the superseded version was 7bbd7a78…). The eyeline direction (up and to his right, viewer-left; concern), the palm cue, the beats and the prompt's structure are unchanged.

1. Take one's eyes were toward the camera and a touch off the lens, as the still has them, not on the lens (your review: "Gaze remains source-like and slightly off-lens"). Section 1, section 4's eyeline and beat 0.0 to 0.5 now say so; the prompt already said "his eyes leave the camera".
2. The start frame's lips are slightly parted (your review: "Lips remain slightly parted as in the source"), so "closed throughout" fails at frame zero by construction. Section 4 and the mouth rule now read: the lips press closed within the first half-second and stay closed; the prompt reads "his lips press closed and stay closed". My second handoff's "natural mouth, closed" was the misread.
3. "One blink at the first second" is one observed eye closure (shut roughly 0.7 to 1.3 s in the eye crops); whether it was the take's only blink awaits playback. Section 1 says so; the take-two check stays "one blink at most".

The superseded delta carries the same note (sha256 613c262157d900dbf42b1ad93699863b0131665770dcbdf0fce5dca020297a76). A second one-agent check of the card itself is still running; anything it finds comes in this thread.

attachments.description: The take-two card with the three baseline corrections (supersedes the version attached to eecae69c).
